summary: The change adds `mergedBy?: string | null` to `GitHubPullRequestV1` and parses `merged_by` in `parsePullWire` (absent or null becomes null, an object login is preserved, and malformed values fail closed). Human-merge provenance now reads the observed actor from live REST reads, and tests cover single-PR and list reads, null/absent actors, malformed actors, and the human-merge completion path through the real port.

evidence: `src/contracts/ports-github-requests.ts` lines 65 to 67 add the optional `mergedBy` login field to `GitHubPullRequestV1`.

`src/github/wire.ts` lines 201 to 203 parse `merged_by` through `expectLogin`, treating absent as null and rejecting malformed objects; line 239 returns it on every parsed pull, which reaches `humanMergeProvenanceRef` through `completeHumanMerge`.
`tests/github/pull-merge-actor_test.ts` verifies `readPullRequest` and `listPullRequestsByHeadRef` preserve the actor separately from the author and fail closed on malformed values.

`tests/repair/human-merge-completion_test.ts` now observes the merged pull through the real GitHub port wire parser with `merged_by`, showing provenance records the observed actor instead of `unknown`.
